impl JobClient {
    /// Puts a thing on the shelf, with its tags and labels.
    ///
    /// A thing already there is replaced.
    pub async fn put_thing(&mut self, request: v1::PutThingRequest) -> Result<v1::PutThingResponse, JobError> {
        let (attempt, request) = self.begin(request);
        let answer = tokio::time::timeout(self.limit, self.service.put_thing(request)).await;
        answer.map_err(|_| self.timed_out(attempt)).and_then(|answer| answer.map(tonic::Response::into_inner).map_err(|status| self.classify(attempt, &status)))
    }

    /// Watches the things on the shelf: one event per change, until the server ends the
    /// stream.
    pub async fn watch_things(&mut self, request: v1::WatchThingsRequest) -> Result<Replies<v1::ThingEvent>, JobError> {
        let (attempt, request) = self.begin(request);
        let answer = tokio::time::timeout(self.limit, self.service.watch_things(request)).await;
        answer.map_err(|_| self.timed_out(attempt)).and_then(|answer| answer.map(|stream| Replies { stream: stream.into_inner(), base: self.base.clone() }).map_err(|status| self.classify(attempt, &status)))
    }

    /// Shapes a thing: its size and its shade.
    pub async fn shape_thing(&mut self, request: v1::ShapeThingRequest) -> Result<v1::ShapeThingResponse, JobError> {
        let (attempt, request) = self.begin(request);
        let answer = tokio::time::timeout(self.limit, self.service.shape_thing(request)).await;
        answer.map_err(|_| self.timed_out(attempt)).and_then(|answer| answer.map(tonic::Response::into_inner).map_err(|status| self.classify(attempt, &status)))

/// The answers of a call the server streams, read one at a time.
pub struct Replies<T> {
    stream: tonic::Streaming<T>,
    base: String,
}

impl<T> Replies<T> {
    /// The next answer, or `None` once the server has ended the stream. The request was
    /// written, so a failure is never [`JobError::NotSent`] for a reason of the network.
    pub async fn next(&mut self) -> Option<Result<T, JobError>> {
        let next = self.stream.message().await.transpose();
        next.map(|answer| answer.map_err(|status| super::error::classify(&self.base, true, &status)))
    }
